articles.title: MacOS malware hijacks Telegram sessions, targets crypto wallets: SlowMist
articles.snippet: A macOS malware steals credentials to hijack Telegram sessions, decrypt cryptocurrency wallets or trick users into entering their wallet recovery phrases through fake applications.

articles.title: Ordinals advocate Leonidas proposes new Bitcoin client: ‘$DOG Mode’
articles.snippet: “Over time the economic incentives will drive $DOG Mode’s adoption and force Bitcoin Core to stop gatekeeping and allow these completely valid transactions,” said Leonidas.

articles.title: Trump teleprompter operator made $100K betting on Kalshi markets tied to speeches: ABC
articles.snippet: According to ABC News, federal regulators are investigating whether the longtime White House staffer used nonpublic information to profit from event contracts tied to President Donald Trump’s speeches.

articles.title: DeepMind CEO Says AGI Will Be Bigger Than Electricity or Fire
articles.snippet: Demis Hassabis says artificial general intelligence is only a few years away and proposes a new U.S. standards body to test frontier AI models before release.
